tagline: Clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing anti-inflammatory therapies for cardiovascular diseases
hero_kpi_rationale: Cardiol is an early-stage clinical-phase company entirely dedicated to developing anti-inflammatory therapies for cardiovascular diseases. R&D intensity reflects the development stage characteristic of pre-commercial biotechs.

risks.title: Critical dependence on third-party manufacturers (Dalton)
risks.score_rationale: Risk explicitly cited in the forward-looking statements list ("dependence on Dalton and other contract manufacturers"). Direct language indicating major operational dependence. Lack of control over future production pricing mentioned separately. Critical industry category for clinical-stage biotech.

risks.title: Clinical uncertainty and risk of trial failure
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned four times in the forward-looking section ("inherent uncertainty of product development", "equivocal or negative results from clinical trials"). Very cautious language reflecting intrinsic uncertainty. Ongoing Phase II ARCHER trial. Existential risk for pre-commercialization biotech.

risks.title: Continuous funding needs and cash burn
risks.score_rationale: Cited first in forward-looking risks ("anticipated cash needs, and the need for additional financing"). Mentioned three times ("requirement for additional financing", "negative cash flow from operations", "history of losses"). Pre-revenue biotech with loss history. Risk of dilution or inability to fund.

risks.title: Intellectual property: defense and freedom-to-operate risks
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly listed ("ability to procure, defend, and/or enforce our intellectual property" and "freedom to operate"). Risk of third-party challenges to ownership ("third-party claims relating to misappropriation"). Meros agreement with complex fields of use. Critical for biotech.

risks.title: Lack of commercial experience and market risk
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly cited ("lack of experience in commercializing any products, including selling, marketing, or distributing"). Also "uncertainty relating to market acceptance of our product candidates". Biotech without commercial track record. Risk of positioning and adoption.

risks.title: Controlled substance regulation and jurisdiction variability
risks.score_rationale: Specifically mentioned ("product candidates being subject to controlled substance laws which may vary from jurisdiction to jurisdiction"). Cardiol develops cannabinoids (Meros agreement). High multi-jurisdictional compliance risk.

risks.title: Product liability and personal injury claims
risks.score_rationale: Cited twice ("claims for personal injury or death arising from the use of our products" and "product liability claims and product recalls"). Inherent risk for pharmaceutical products. Possible insufficient insurance coverage.

risks.title: Intense competition and technology obsolescence risk
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned ("competition in our industry" and "inability to develop new technologies and products and the obsolescence of existing technologies"). Highly competitive cardiovascular market with established players. Risk of technological disruption.

ai_positioning.summary: Cardiol Therapeutics does not mention AI or machine learning in its drug development or operations. The company focuses on traditional clinical research centered on CardiolRx (cannabidiol) for cardiovascular diseases.
evidence: No mention of AI or machine learning in Form 40-F filings
